Messages.Author: Claus Staal
Messages.Body:
I was just wondering about retainers, equipment, inherent abilities,
etc.etc.

Obviously a Methuselah can't "turn" off the inherent abilities of
vampires (i.e. +1 intercept for Anton or +2 Bleed for IC's). The
opposite must apply for equipment, in that they are all optional (with
the exception of The Soul Gem which is Mandatory). But how about
retainers? Do you actually need to use a given retainer? Lets say you
previously "equipped" with a Marijava Ghoul - making all your presence
bleeds at a default +1 stealth - can this retainer be "turned" off?? Or
is its use mandatory after equipping with it?? Could a vampire refuse to
receive the blood from the faithful servant while in torpor or ... ??

Please advice!

Kind Regards and thanks in advance!

Claus Staal
Prince of Copenhagen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Yes. Sorry I missed that item in the first post. Equipment is mandatory.
(Note that for weapons, this means that the bearer *always* has the
ability to strike with the weapon, not that striking with the weapon is
mandatory).
